data.title: Inside Grant Cardone's $230M real estate and bitcoin strategy
data.description:
Scott Melker sits down with Cardone Capital CEO Grant Cardone to discuss his $230 million strategy combining real estate and bitcoin  (BTC-USD). Cardone breaks down his 50/50 investment approach, why he's scaling back his ambitious goal of owning 100,000 apartments to 25,000, and how the shift could help optimize his real estate portfolio while increasing his exposure to bitcoin.

"The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto.
